reason: E1 shows CrTaO4 reduced oxidation in a related alloy and suggests reduced Ti promotes it, but does not test a Cr-coating on equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr. E2 describes electrospark deposition for HEAs but provides no evidence of Cr-rich coatings or their oxidation performance. The key premise that a Cr-coating will form protective CrTaO4 on this specific alloy is unsupported by the cited evidence.
